default_action.rationale: S0 denies process and network capability paths explicitly; general syscall minimization is a later hardening slice.

condition.rationale: Classic seccomp cannot inspect clone3's pointed-to flags; S0 therefore denies clone3 rather than risk child creation.

compilation_contract.unknown_syscall: record_not_exposed_only_when libseccomp and a direct ENOSYS probe agree for the selected architecture; otherwise fail
compilation_contract.observer: record every attempted denied syscall and decoded arguments independently of seccomp enforcement

self_test_contract.coverage: one isolated probe for every syscall named by every rule on the selected architecture
self_test_contract.conditional_rule_coverage: clone is probed once without CLONE_THREAD and once with CLONE_THREAD; the former must be denied and the latter must not be denied by this rule
self_test_contract.preopened_resources: network-I/O and io_uring operation probes receive resources created before the filter is installed
self_test_contract.expected_denied_result: EPERM plus a matching observer event
self_test_contract.not_exposed_result: an explicit architecture-qualified not_exposed record with libseccomp resolution and direct ENOSYS evidence
